name: DataOne Grenoble (Eybens) AI hosting campus
notes: BSO/DataOne acquired Tier-3 campuses in Grenoble (Eybens) and Villefontaine with 15 MW combined initial IT load; actu.fr reports the Eybens mega project worth EUR 800m creating an AI data center, with commissioning expected from summer 2025; Data Center Map lists expansion ambitions up to 400 MW.

name: DataOne Lyon (Villefontaine)
notes: Marketed as Lyon, the facility is at Villefontaine, Isère (38); part of DataOne's two-campus French AI platform. Le Dauphiné (2025-04-10) reports a local petition and public meeting over the Villefontaine data center project, indicating community debate around the site.

name: Cogent Data Center - Grenoble
notes: Cogent lists Grenoble among its French data-center markets; Data Center Map lists a Cogent Grenoble facility at 33 Rue Joseph Chanrion; capacity not disclosed.

name: Omega 1
developer: Omega Data Centers / Océinde / THD Group
notes: Omega 1 at Le Port is La Réunion's first Tier-3-equivalent ISO 27001/HDS data center (1 MW, ~120 racks); AFD financed the island's first data center; 2026 posts say Omega 1 now hosts the first AI-hosting capacity of the territory (Exodata 'Follow the Sun' offer).

name: Bois Rouge data center project, Saint-André
notes: Clicanoo reports a data center project planned at Bois Rouge, Saint-André (La Réunion); the 'Demain La Réunion' movement calls for abandoning it while the water-supply crisis persists, signalling active community opposition; developer and capacity not yet public.

name: NXO OI Saint-Denis data center
notes: Directory listing says NXO Océan Indien operates two data centers on Réunion Island and identifies the Saint-Denis Technor facility at 16 Rue Albert Lougnon.

name: GCS Tesis Datacenter HDS
notes: GCS Tesis states its HDS data center is locally implanted in La Réunion providing low-latency hosting for local applications.

name: DATA3 Pulseo data center
notes: Dax facility at Pulseo, 1 Avenue de la Gare, described as a Tier III data center in production since 2013; DCmag map lists Aditu Data3 in Landes.

name: Izarralde Dax data center project
notes: Izarralde's own post describes a planned new Dax data center to strengthen its South Aquitaine sovereign/proximity hosting network; capacity not disclosed.

name: C-Datacenters Saint-Etienne DC1
notes: Groupe Casino says C-Datacenters develops and operates local data centers in France and that the Saint-Etienne site is already in operation.

name: UltraEdge Saint-Etienne datacenter
notes: UltraEdge's own datacenter page identifies its Saint-Etienne facility as part of its French local data-center network.

name: Flexicore DC1-STE
notes: Flexicore states it operates two Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes data centers, including DC1-STE in Saint-Etienne, Loire (42).

name: DENV-R Floating Data Center Nantes
notes: Nantes Saint-Nazaire Port reported inauguration at Quai Wilson; DCD reported the floating, river-cooled Nantes data center offers 200 kW; Environnement Magazine (2025-01) covers the river-cooling design.

name: Blue Nantes data center
notes: Blue's official Nantes page describes its local resilient hosting datacenter; infonet (2026-07-02) reports Blue opened the Nantes data center for digital sovereignty; Baxtel lists Blue Nantes as the largest Pays de la Loire facility with 2 MW.

name: ETIX Nantes data centers
notes: ETIX says it is the regional data-center leader in Western France with three interconnected sites in the greater Nantes area (ETIX Nantes #1 at Saint-Herblain identified) and one in Vendée.

name: Cogent Data Center - Nantes
notes: Cogent lists Nantes among its French data-center markets; service-location listing identifies Cogent Data Center - Nantes at 32 Boulevard Victor Hugo.

name: Zetoon Nantes data center
notes: GridReadiness aggregator lists Zetoon Nantes as a 3 MW Tier III data center in Nantes (44), subject to RTE connection rules; aggregator-grade lead pending operator-page verification.

name: Orange Amilly data center
notes: Orange commissioned the Amilly data center in 2022; DCD reports 16,000 sq m building and 5,000 sq m computer rooms; Baxtel lists the Amilly facility in Centre-Val de Loire with 6 MW.

name: Fumel former foundry slag heap datacenter project
developer: Frédéric Michel / David Grimbert / Paul Cohen (reported project sponsors)
notes: DCmag, citing local Lot-et-Garonne press, reported a datacenter project on the former Fumel foundry slag heap site of about 66,026 sqm; capacity not disclosed.

name: BJM Data Mende datacenter
notes: Lozère departmental publication describes the first Lozère datacenter installed in Mende, operated by BJMData for secure archival, backup, storage and hosting services; equivalent Tier 3 level, capacity not disclosed.

name: Margeride AI/data center investor site concept
developer: Département de la Lozère / prospective investors
notes: Radio Totem reported the department president publicly called for investors to install a data center in Lozère, citing potential sites on the Margeride, renewable-energy access, A75 fiber, and cooling advantages; no named investor or capacity yet.

name: Datacenter métropolitain d'Angers / Université d'Angers Belle-Beille
developer: Université d'Angers / Angers Loire Métropole / Région Pays de la Loire / Département de Maine-et-Loire
notes: SIEN Pays de la Loire describes the Angers metropolitan datacenter as the result of work since 2014 for local higher education and public bodies; Jerlaure project sheet says Université d'Angers entrusted construction of a Tier III datacenter on Belle-Beille campus.

name: UniMedia Angers / La Salle Blanche Melisa
notes: UniMédia states it offers hosting, Nutanix VMs in Angers and Nantes, and colocation; Data Center Map lists La Salle Blanche Melisa in Angers as a colocation facility.

name: DeepData Saumur underground datacenter demonstrator
notes: L'Usine Digitale reported the DeepData datacenter installed in underground quarries in the Saumur area had been operational for five months; article gives 3,200 terabits but not MW.

name: Zeus Data Center Big Nuage, Saumur area
notes: DCD listed 'Zeus Data Center plans first data center, Big Nuage, in Saumur, France'; Clubic reported the underground project in the Saumur area targets 200 MW and is backed by Zeus Data Center, based in Longué-Jumelles.

name: Dataouest Saint-Lô/Agneaux datacenters
notes: Dataouest says it hosts customer information systems in its Saint-Lô datacenter and has built its own datacenters in Normandy; company history describes the first private 100% Manche data center and later retention of the Agneaux datacenter.

name: La Hague / Cotentin AI data center candidate site
developer: Région Normandie / prospective AI datacenter investors
notes: DCmag and Le Journal des Entreprises reported Normandy identified La Hague, along with Colombelles near Caen, as potential sites for AI datacenters from the national AI-site effort; actu.fr assesses the Cotentin's suitability (Flamanville) for one of the giant AI data centers France wants to create; no final developer or capacity disclosed.

name: Hexanet Reims datacenters
notes: Hexanet describes a 100%-owned Tier III+/ISO 27001/HDS main datacenter in Reims and a secondary Reims datacenter for business continuity, with disclosed electrical/cooling figures but no total MW.

name: Ikoula IKDC01 Reims
notes: Ikoula says it owns two data centers in eastern France, with IKDC01 as its main Reims (51) data center; the page lists 1,750 sqm total area, 750 sqm maximum capacity, 550 sqm production area, and site upgradability to 3,000 kVA.

name: Hodi FDF1 Le Lamentin datacenter
notes: Data Center Map lists one Martinique data center market at Le Lamentin and identifies Hodi FDF1 at Immeuble Objectif 3000 with 0.1 MW and Tier 3; treated as aggregate evidence pending operator page.

name: France Caraïbes Data Center (FCDC), Fort-de-France
notes: French government business directory and Kompass identify France Caraïbes Data Center in Fort-de-France, founded 2008, with activity code for data processing, hosting and related activities; facility capacity not disclosed.

name: Exodata Martinique proximity datacenter
notes: Exodata, the overseas hosting operator, describes its Martinique proximity data center offering (human-scale, sovereign hosting) on its own site; facility-level capacity not disclosed.

name: MCT Synapse Laval datacenters
notes: MCT states it has two datacenters in Mayenne, including two in Laval; Mayenne departmental article says MCT's Synapse building on rue de Paris in Laval houses the main data center and that MCT operates its own secure data centers.

name: Luminess Mayenne/Laval HDS data centers
notes: Luminess HDS certificate lists data center scopes at 1 Rue Dr Louis Sauvé, 53100 Mayenne; 14 rue Jules Méline, 53000 Laval; and 561 rue Saint-Léonard, 53100 Mayenne. Capacity not disclosed.

name: ITH Center Mamoudzou
developer: Information Technology Hosting SAS / ITH Center
notes: ITH Center official page describes Mayotte's first neutral Tier III colocation datacenter in Mamoudzou/Kawéni, operating since 2022 with 80 racks and 215 sqm white space; AFD says it was inaugurated on 2022-10-21; Data Center Map lists 0.65 MW.
